landing.title: Self-Hosted WebDAV On Cloudflare Workers
landing.subtitle: Buckets Backed By Durable Objects, Served Over WebDAV. Each Bucket Has Its Own Credentials; Private Buckets Stay Protected.
landing.webdavDescription: Mount, Sync, And Edit With Any WebDAV Client.
landing.edgeStorageDescription: One Durable Object Per Bucket, SQLite-Backed.
landing.accessControlDescription: Per-Bucket Credentials For WebDAV; Cloudflare Access For The Web UI.

dashboard.empty: No Buckets Yet. Create One To Get Started.

volumes.descriptionPlaceholder: A Short Description Of This Bucket
volumes.visibilityHint: Private Buckets Need A Bucket Credential For Every Request. Public Buckets Allow Anonymous Reads.
volumes.hrefPrefixModeDescription: Controls The Path WebDAV Clients See In File Links. The Default Includes Your Bucket Name, Which Is What Most Clients Expect. Some Clients Require Paths Starting At The Root Instead.
volumes.deleteBucketDescription: Permanently Deletes The Bucket, Its Files, And Its Credentials. This Cannot Be Undone.
volumes.visibilityDescription: Changing Visibility Affects Who Can Read This Bucket. Making It Public Exposes Files To Anyone.

credentials.hint: Each Credential Unlocks Only This Bucket. Use The Generated Username And Password As WebDAV Basic Auth.
credentials.invalidExpiry: Expiry Must Be A Positive Number Of Days.
credentials.readOnlyHint: Can Browse And Download, But Cannot Upload, Delete, Or Rename.
credentials.created: Credential Created. Copy The Password Now — It Will Not Be Shown Again.

files.notFound: This Folder Does Not Exist Or You Do Not Have Access.
files.invalidName: Enter A Single File Or Folder Name.

replication.title: Replication
replication.description: Keep This Bucket In Sync With Another WebDAV Server, On A Schedule. Changes Move In Both Directions.
replication.httpsOnly: Https Only. Loopback And Private Network Addresses Are Blocked Unless The Operator Has Allowed Them.
replication.secretStored: Stored Encrypted With The Server Key. It Is Never Shown Again — Change It By Adding A New Target.
replication.syncStarted: Sync Started. It Continues In The Background.
replication.passInFlight: A Sync Pass Is In Progress. Deletions Propagate Only After A Pass Finishes Without Errors.
replication.conflictResolved: Both Sides Changed. {{winner}} Side Was Kept.

modeHelp.pullOnly: One Way: The Remote Is The Only Writer. Changes Here Are Never Sent Back. A Local Version That Would Be Replaced Is Saved Beside It First.

replication.mirrorDeletions: Delete Files Here That The Remote Does Not Have
replication.mirrorDeletionsHelp: Off, This Bucket Is A Safe Copy: The Remote’s Files Are Imported, And Nothing Here Is Ever Deleted. On, It Becomes An Exact Mirror — Off, Only After A Sync Pass Finishes Without Errors.
